assessments.reasoning: The five contiguous parts of SPDX json/details/CC-BY-3.0-IGO.json cover 67,353 bytes. The record gives licenseId CC-BY-3.0-IGO, isDeprecatedLicenseId false, the IGO definition and https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/igo/legalcode in crossRef and seeAlso.

The GitHub API for spdx/license-list-data identifies annotated tag object 76c9a79bb7d2bf851143b76b3935a4d7cbaa644b as v3.29.0. Its object.type is commit and its target is 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48, exactly the JSON source revision. The tag is unsigned.

As context, the Creative Commons receipt at the cited URL identifies the exact BY 3.0 IGO page with SHA-256 2013ded9092fb98ce2e16252a73909ff462609458896238ac578f427eaef1923. SPDX controls the membership assertion.

challenge.method: Compared crossRef[0].url and seeAlso[0] with the acquisition URL, HTML canonical link and instrument landing page. Checked the annotated tag object separately from its target commit as required for release-specific attribution under SCES sections 3 and 7.
challenge.results: Both SPDX fields end in /by/3.0/igo/legalcode. The publisher declares /legalcode.en in the HTML head and displays the /igo/ landing URL separately. The generated file comes from the tag’s target commit.

limitations: The finding concerns the tagged SPDX record and a literal URL match. The generated text shares publisher lineage. Its formatting and title prefix do not establish byte identity, legal equivalence, translation equivalence or downstream applicability.
